core_obligations: Apply the resolution construction of the preceding lemma in the abelian category of complexes of O_X-modules to the adjoint pair f^* and f_*, obtaining a resolution of F by the f_*f^* iterates, termwise flasque, whose stalkwise comparison with F[0] is a homotopy equivalence of complexes of complexes of O_{X,x}-modules (proof lines 7093-7120).

Totalize the double complex given by that resolution of complexes and read off boundedness below and termwise flasqueness of the total complex G, using that F is bounded below so each term of G is a finite direct sum of flasque terms (proof lines 7121-7135).
Transfer the stalkwise homotopy equivalence from the double complex to G by the homotopy lemma, and note that this in particular makes F to G a quasi-isomorphism (proof lines 7136-7140).
proof_roadmap: Lift the Godement resolution to complexes (proof lines 7093-7120).
Totalize and check boundedness and flasqueness (proof lines 7121-7135).
Transfer the homotopy equivalence to the total complex (proof lines 7136-7140).
difficulty_reason: For a ringed space (X, O_X) and a bounded below complex F of O_X-modules, the lemma produces a quasi-isomorphism F to G with G a bounded below complex of flasque modules whose stalkwise map is a homotopy equivalence of complexes of O_{X,x}-modules (statement lines 7080-7091). The proof transplants the one sheaf resolution to complexes by viewing complexes of O_X-modules as an abelian category and repeating the construction with the adjoint pair f^* and f_*: one obtains a resolution of F by the f_*f^* iterates, each of whose terms is termwise flasque and whose stalkwise comparison with F[0] is a homotopy equivalence of complexes of complexes (proof lines 7093-7120). The total complex G of that double complex is then shown to be bounded below, with each term a finite direct sum of flasque terms, because F is bounded below; the stalkwise homotopy equivalence statement is transferred from the double complex to its totalization by the homotopy lemma for complexes of complexes (proof lines 7121-7137). The claim is H2: the resolution itself is cited from the preceding lemma, and the content is the passage to complexes and the boundedness and flasqueness bookkeeping.
